identifiedBy.fact: Cross Kearsarge Pass, descend to Bubbs Creek (Kearsarge Pass trail starts at Onion Valley)

otherFacts.value: over Kearsarge Pass, down to Bubbs Creek, up Vidette Creek cross-country

notes: First pass missed that the text names Kearsarge Pass. Kearsarge Pass is reached only from Onion Valley on the east side (Onion Valley road end); the Kearsarge Pass trail from Onion Valley is documented on the Center Peak report (https://climber.org/reports/1998/311.html). Inference from the pass name, not a page about Deerhorn. A Kearsarge Pass entry from the west (Cedar Grove/Bubbs Creek) would not 'cross' it descending to Bubbs Creek, so Onion Valley is the consistent reading. One placement; USFS point is the campground, ~100 m from the road-end lot.
